abstract: “Forget HD! You want to upgrade to UHD HDR!” was the third comment in the Facebook thread on my timeline the other night. Usually I would let those comments slide but this time, my interest was engaged. This wasn’t a professional TV group, this was a community group for one of my small neighboring villages in the U.K. with about 2000 inhabitants. The conversation usually covers pubs, potholes, farming, and the local school, so a mention of high dynamic range (HDR) was very strange indeed.
